editorial.topic: 윌리엄 왕세자, BBC One 그레이엄 노턴 쇼(2026-10-23)에서 어릴 때 경찰관과 DJ를 꿈꿨고 DJ 예명이 'DJ Xara'(X로 쓰는 자라)였다고 밝힘

sources.title: Prince William Could Have Been A DJ | The Graham Norton Show
sources.publisher: The Graham Norton Show (YouTube, 공식 채널)
sources.evidenceSummary: 공식 채널 클립(1분 15초). 영어 자동 생성 자막 원문: "I did want to be a policeman when I was younger. I thought I could make a good policeman." / "You're tall." "I'm tall, exactly. Um, so that'd be the idea." "There's a bit more to it than that." / "Being a policeman I thought was quite cool. And then I went through a phase where I wanted to be a DJ, which didn't go very well. And I came up with a name. I was called DJ Xara with an X. It wasn't good." / "DJ Xara?" "With an X, yeah." "Where's the X?" "The X is at the front." / "Did you DJ at school parties?" "Uh, no, I didn't. I never got that good." 캡션 따옴표 "꽤 멋있다" = "I thought was quite cool", "잘 안 풀렸다" = "which didn't go very well", "그 정도로 잘하진 못했다" = "I never got that good".

sources.title: Prince William Used DJ Xara as Music Career Stage Name
sources.evidenceSummary: 10월 23일 방송분에서 윌리엄 왕세자가 "I went through a phase where I wanted to be a DJ, which didn't go very well", "I was called 'DJ Xara' with an X", "Being a policeman, I thought was quite cool"라고 말했다고 보도(작성 Sabba Rahbar). 시각은 페이지 표기 11:33 PM 기준, 시간대 미확인.

sources.title: Prince William says he once dreamed of being a policeman or a DJ
sources.evidenceSummary: BBC One 금요일 밤 방송에서 윌리엄 왕세자가 경찰관이 "quite cool"하다고 생각했고 DJ Xara 시절엔 "wasn't very good"였다고 말했으며, 어스샷 상을 알리러 나와 케이트 블란쳇·해나 워딩엄·로버트 어윈과 함께 출연했다고 보도. 정치 발언은 보도되지 않음.
sources.usageNote: GB News(https://www.gbnews.com/royal/prince-william-dj-name), Stuff(https://www.stuff.co.nz/world-news/361050626/prince-william-reveals-he-once-wanted-be-dj-or-policeman)도 같은 내용을 보도했다(검색 결과로만 확인).
